##### Project general facts

Ayamore Residence by AYAT Development is a contemporary waterfront building that pairs refined design with a calm coastal lifestyle. Soft facade lines, floating slabs, glass balustrades and full-height windows fill the interiors with natural light and open up sweeping sea views. The building rises above a ground floor and two amenity podium levels to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious three-bedroom villas with generous balconies and terraces.

Residents are welcomed through luxury lobbies and enjoy an infinity pool with a cocktail pool area and pool concierge, a shaded children's pool, an indoor gym, an outdoor fitness zone and a yoga area with a vertical garden. An outdoor cinema, a party and entertainment zone, a barbecue area, table tennis, landscaped gardens, a children's play area and a pet wash station add variety, complemented by a beach buggy service and direct access to the boardwalk.

Interiors combine warm timber battens, travertine and softly veined marble to create a calm, tactile palette inspired by nature and local tradition. Open-plan living and dining spaces flow into elegant kitchens with fluted islands, breakfast bars and generous storage, while bedrooms are framed by floor-to-ceiling glazing and sculptural lighting. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront master community of five man-made islands off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods, resorts, marinas and long stretches of public beach. Landscaped promenades, parks and cycling paths run along the shoreline, while hotels, beach clubs and waterfront dining venues give the islands a relaxed resort character close to the historic heart of the city.

The Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with Deira, Bur Dubai and the city centre. Dubai Islands Beach, the Waterfront Market and the Gold Souk are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
